g:HTMLPanel.p: Light and dark themes: ColorModeHelper writes Bootstrap's data-bs-theme on the page or on a single widget.

d:Example.heading: On one widget
d:Example.description: `ColorModeHelper.setColorMode(widget, ColorMode.DARK)` darkens a widget and everything in it, whatever the page's mode. Widgets with a `type` of `ColorMode`, like `Navbar`, do it from UiBinder.

d:Example.heading: The whole page
d:Example.description: `setPageColorMode` sets the mode of the page; `followSystem()` follows the browser's light or dark preference until you remove the registration it returns. The menu at the top of this demo does the same.
